title: Unsupported operating systems support production
description: Multiple production servers and engineering workstations are reported outside standard vendor support; exact versions and isolation require validation.

title: Core manufacturing platform lacks a funded replacement plan
description: A bespoke production platform relies on obsolete components and has no approved migration business case.

title: Flat network paths connect corporate and operational environments
description: Network diagrams indicate broad connectivity between corporate services and selected operational systems.

title: Privileged access uses shared administrator credentials
description: Shared privileged credentials are reported across legacy infrastructure support teams.

title: Security logging is limited on legacy platforms
description: Several critical legacy platforms cannot forward complete telemetry to the central monitoring service.

title: Recovery testing excludes operational technology dependencies
description: Recovery tests do not demonstrate restoration of production scheduling and operational dependencies.

title: Patch backlog includes externally reachable services
description: A synthetic sample identifies overdue patches on internet-reachable and remote-access services.

title: Asset inventory is incomplete
description: The infrastructure inventory does not reconcile fully to vulnerability and support records.

title: Incident-response plans do not cover operational shutdown
description: Response playbooks do not clearly allocate decisions for a cyber-related production shutdown.

title: Third-party remote access is inconsistently governed
description: Maintenance providers use different remote-access methods and review evidence is incomplete.
